selector.champion: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis
selector.rationale: The presence of a well-defined erythematous plaque with overlying ulceration, histopathological findings of a circumscribed tumor with papillary projections and atypical cells, and immunohistochemical analysis showing p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers support the diagnosis of Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis.
